claim_class: established cross-material/target-chemistry experimental evidence plus project inference
decision_claim: For D18/BTP-eC9, a hole-transport-layer change materially alters the 1 cm^2 scale penalty, so contact/interlayer control is a required conventional falsifier before attributing B0/B1/B2 useful-work changes to interface/EPC physics.

source.title: Topology-Engineered Coordination Polymers for Enhanced Hole Transport in Organic Solar Cells

validity_domain: Descriptive comparison of the source Table 1 D18/BTP-eC9 devices only; not a causal decomposition, not a D18/PY-IT/eC9 acceptance threshold, and not stabilized-Pmax evidence.
falsifier: A prospectively randomized B0/B1/B2 campaign using controlled identical contacts/interlayers that shows the same useful-work effect across independent lots while direct contact/transport diagnostics remain unchanged would bound this conventional explanation.
